notes.title: OUT TOMORROW: The Plane Effect
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40933079/62b5e0f7d0d92d62b45f4672b4b07fb6d3ba981a.png

We're very excited to say that The Plane Effect finally launches tomorrow, 23 September on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X!

Wishlist the main game now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1448760/The_Plane_Effect/
